items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1962-11-01
items.q: this boy, Herbert, you see, when I had to get divorced, Herbert, you know, decided to run around and he's mad, I see, and he paid the wedding.

ctx.x: Man, look, his wife was so tired, man, she really was bored out, you know. And she sat down there, you know, she, she, she, she wondering if she was, must get up or, or, or, what she wanted to do, you know. She didn't know what to do, she was so bored out. She just sat there. I said, what's the matter? Oh, Lord, I'm sure he's tired. So, you know, look, you know what her husband said? Well, I didn't tell you to come over here. That's what he told you, you know. And look, he snatched up like that, you know. I made…
Oh, well, they're all mixed in there.
